TL;DR: Sign up for the Aristotle Lean API at aristotle.harmonic.fun!

Hi Folks,

I'm Vikram from Harmonic, and am excited to share that we are starting to rollout API access to Aristotle. You can sign up at aristotle.harmonic.fun! The API is designed to complete the sorries in your project - here are few more details:

  1. Aristotle integrates cleanly into your existing projects, and can follow dependencies and even use definitions and theorems you have locally in completing proofs.
  2. Aristotle can find counterexamples to statements automatically, helping discover logical errors, missed edge cases, or even misformalizations.
  3. You can guide Aristotle in Lean or English. It can fill in the holes of your formal proof, even completing more than one sorry in a single theorem. Aristotle can also follow your English proofs - just add a comment above the statement you are proving, tagged with "PROVIDED SOLUTION".

We'd love to have you try it out and let us know what you think and how we can continue to improve the API!
Further discussion will take place in #mathlib4 > Discussion thread for Aristotle API and #Machine Learning for Theorem Proving > Sign Up for the Aristotle API!
